name: Arsaze
summary: Full video editor for creators and editors: cut silences and filler words, add captions timed to every word, and press Tab to repeat edits. Local desktop features are free forever.
description: Full video editor for creators and editors: cut silences and filler words, add captions timed to every word, and press Tab to repeat edits. Local desktop features are free forever.

pricing.details: Free 0 €/month — 50 one-time welcome AI credits for audio analysis only, 1 hr/month cloud rendering, 2 GB storage, 1 concurrent AI job. Basic 5 €/month — 150 AI credits/month, all AI features, 2.5 hrs cloud rendering, 10 GB, 2 concurrent jobs. Pro 23 €/month — 800 credits/month, 12 hrs, 50 GB, 3 jobs. Studio 90 €/month — 2,900 credits/month, 60 hrs, 250 GB, 8 jobs. Official credit packs: 100=2 €, 250=4 €, 500=8 €, 1,000=15 €, 2,500=36 €, 5,000=68 € (top-up credits never expire). Local desktop features (transcription, background removal and exports on your computer) are free forever, no credits and no watermark.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Full video editor for creators: cut silences and filler words, captions timed to every word, Tab to repeat edits
Complete editor (timeline, color, audio, captions, delivery) on every plan; Windows, Mac and Linux
Local transcription, background removal and exports are free forever, no credits and no watermark
Optional AI assistant connector for Claude, ChatGPT or Grok
